api: compare_corpus emits BasicTextNormalizer delta and ranking_inadmissible

rules.zh: NFKC full-width to half-width; OpenCC t2s on both sides; strip CJK/ASCII punctuation and all whitespace; Han CER with embedded Latin/digit runs as single tokens.
rules.ru: NFKC; lowercase; fold ё to е on both sides; remove U+0301 only; retain internal hyphenated tokens; strip punctuation while preserving semantic symbols as tokens.
rules.fr: NFKC; lowercase; preserve diacritics; U+2019 to ASCII apostrophe; retain elisions and internal hyphenated forms as one token.
rules.es: NFKC; lowercase; preserve diacritics; remove inverted ¿/¡; strip remaining punctuation while preserving semantic symbols as tokens.
rules.en: whisper-normalizer EnglishTextNormalizer; raw text remains available to callers.

basic_text_normalizer_control.scope: Frozen 50-pair rule-sensitivity fixture, n=10 per language. This is not a model/dataset ranking cell.
basic_text_normalizer_control.interpretation: The deliberately rule-sensitive fixture confirms that English number/title normalization, ZH t2s, and RU ё/stress handling can move scores far beyond 2 pp. These cells therefore demonstrate why BasicTextNormalizer is a control only; they do not rank an ASR model.

live_asr_cell_dependency.dependency: Lane C raw references and hypotheses do not exist in this branch at B2 freeze time.
live_asr_cell_dependency.required_follow_up: Lane C must call compare_corpus on every real model/language/dataset/condition cell and strike any |delta| > 2 pp.
